payload.title: Newsroom home page shows the Cyclotron classifier status (v1, from the status operation)
payload.description:
Ryan 11-02: show the Cyclotron classifier's information on the newsroom home page, top right (above the list on a phone). Only this site's classifier, never another site's on a shared run.

Built in PR on feature/newsroom-home-cyclotron: router task cyclotron-status (hourly, own lock, 503 = no snapshot yet, never a lab pause) keeps one CYCLOTRONSTATUS#<publicationId> row per publication in the monitoring table; the Monitoring view serves monitoringPage(list cyclotronStatus) for the signed-in site's own publication only; HomeCyclotronPanel on /newsroom; CLI: papyrus monitors page --list cyclotronStatus. Docs: docs/monitoring-cloud.md#cyclotron-status-for-the-newsroom-home-page.

Deploy needed (not done): CloudFormation for papyrus-monitoring (two schedules, router Lambda code), the engine release, and a site version bump (monitoring-view Lambda and newsroom UI) in one batch. No IAM or data-model change.

Follow-ups: (1) when Cyclotron publishes the read-only report operation (history over time, the supporting questions behind a decision), load it beside the status rows and render it in the HomeCyclotronPanel extra slot; build nothing against the draft. (2) After votes train hosted runs, the panel's no-retraining sentence changes by itself from the snapshot. (3) Merge coordination with PR #1078 (newsroom home header, a small conflict at the title block).
